sources.title: EU AI Act Article 10: Data and Data Governance — Official Text
sources.claim: Article 10 treats synthetic training data as legally equivalent to real data; requires identical governance for high-risk AI systems. Fully applicable August 2, 2026.
sources.notes: Primary legal source; direct text of the regulation

sources.title: How does the EU AI Act affect synthetic data for AI development?
sources.claim: Article 59 of EU AI Act explicitly allows synthetic data use in regulatory AI sandboxes as alternative to personal data
sources.notes: Good practical analysis of Article 10 and Article 59 implications

sources.title: The Role of Synthetic Data within the European Artificial Intelligence Act
sources.claim: EU AI Act compliance deadlines and enforcement approach for synthetic training data documentation
sources.notes: Detailed legal interpretation; ClearBox AI is an EU AI compliance consultancy

data_quality_notes.market_size: Multiple reputable research firms give differing 2026 valuations ($710M–$947M range). We use the Fortune Business Insights figure of $791.34M as our primary reference, noting the range. All sources agree on 30–40% CAGR trajectory.
data_quality_notes.market_share: Individual vendor market share percentages are not publicly available. Share estimates marked [unverified] are the research team's directional assessments based on funding, employee count, and customer references — NOT sourced from market research.
data_quality_notes.adoption_figures: The '35%+ of Fortune 500 in production' figure comes from survey-based research with undisclosed sample methodology (Luiz Neto AI Research). The Gartner '75% by end of 2024' figure is widely cited but behind a paywall — verified via secondary citations across 6+ independent sources.
data_quality_notes.acquisition_price: NVIDIA/Gretel $320M acquisition price confirmed by multiple technology news sources (Wifitalents, Tracxn, multiple tech blogs); NVIDIA and Gretel did not publicly disclose the exact figure per standard M&A practice.
